instruction.text: Fill in the gaps to solve the problem.

atoms.a: Vin cut up two pizzas into eighths. He ate 12/8 of the pizzas. Work out how much pizza is left over.
After Christmas Day, the Davies family were left with 4/6 of their turkey. On Boxing Day, they ate another 1/6 of the turkey. Work out how much turkey is left.
Marcus had a full tank when he left home for work. When he came back home, he had 3/16 of a tank left. Work out how much fuel he used on his journey.

hint.text: A full tank here is equal to <mat>16/16</mat>.

atoms.a: Phil ate 2/5 of a chocolate bar, and Janet ate 3/5. Work out how much chocolate is left.

atoms.b:
Jim has written: 2/10 + 2/10 + 2/10 = 6/10
He must still write: 10/10 - 6/10 = 4/10
atoms.a: Jim has been writing 2/10 of his story every day this week since Monday. Today is Wednesday. Work out how much of his story he still has to write.
